verdict.line: You lose when you feed a full Q chain into an up Riposte; you win when you bait W (Riposte) empty and then commit your all-in.

brief.thesis: Both champions are combo-dependent and both have exactly one tool that punishes a wasted combo: Fiora's W (Riposte) parries whichever hit you commit to, and Aatrox's Q (The Darkin Blade) only does full damage across all three sequential slashes. At 48% over 533 games with lane and solo-kill graded even, this isn't a matchup you're behind in — it's decided by who blinks first and dumps their cooldown into nothing.

theirWindow.when: Riposte (W) is up, you overextend Q3
theirWindow.what: If you throw your third Q slash or R (World Ender) engage into an available Riposte, she parries it, stuns you, and swings the trade hard her way. Poke with W (Infernal Chains) or a single auto first to force it out before committing your real damage.

yourWindow.what: The moment she uses W to parry a poke or it's down from a prior trade, you have a clean window to land the full Q1-Q2-Q3 chain plus E (Umbral Dash) reposition without a parry threat — this is when you all-in.

start.why: Rated 49.6% over 337 games and the more popular choice (52.6% pick) over Doran's Shield's 49.3% — the extra lifesteal and AD matter more here since you want to win short trades outright rather than stall.

boots.why: The clear standard at 50.1% WR and 89% pick — Fiora's damage is entirely physical (autos, Q, empowered E autos), so flat reduction on her poke and her Riposte counter-hit outvalues Mercury's Treads' 54% over a much smaller 50-game sample.

core.why: The proc's shield and burst window is what lets you force a trade before her vitals fully reveal, and it's the first item in the best-performing path (54.5% over 33 games).
Completes the highest-rated recorded core path with Eclipse and Death's Dance — the on-hit proc rewards landing your empowered Q slashes in the extended trades this matchup produces.
Caps the 54.5%-WR path; the damage-over-time conversion lets you survive her return hits after a Riposte parry instead of dying to the delayed damage.

situational.when: you want faster cooldown uptime on Q resets instead of Sundered Sky — the Eclipse-into-Shojin path hit 66.7% WR, though on a small 12-game sample
her passive vitals healing and lifesteal are keeping her alive through your all-ins
you're getting outsustained by her vitals procs and want the grievous wounds earlier than Executioner's Calling

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing on hit rewards exactly the multi-slash Q trades this lane is built around, and it's the keystone behind both recorded rune pages for this matchup.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick (76.1% pick rate, 50.5% WR) and the Ignite denies her passive vitals sustain during all-in windows; Flash+Teleport (45.4% WR, 20.9% pick) is the fallback if you expect a longer, more static lane where scaling and map presence matter more than kill pressure.

playing.title: Bait Riposte before your real combo
playing.detail: Throw W (Infernal Chains) or a single auto in first. If she parries that, her W is down and your next Q chain or R engage is completely safe.

playing.title: Track her vitals, not just her HP
playing.detail: Her passive reveals a glowing vital on you; once she strikes one she heals and gets bonus movement speed plus reduced cooldowns. Disengage the instant you see the vital proc rather than continuing the trade.

playing.title: Use E to dodge her Q reset window
playing.detail: Umbral Dash lets you sidestep her Lunge (Q) follow-up; a dodged Q resets her nothing and wastes the cooldown she needs to keep pace with your Q chain.

playing.title: All-in only when Riposte is down
playing.detail: Confirm her W is on cooldown before committing R (World Ender) — with Riposte gone, your sustain and empowered autos win the extended fight outright.

playing.title: Respect her empowered E autos
playing.detail: Bladework gives her two extended-range, faster autos — don't walk up for a free trade right after she activates it; wait it out or use E to close distance only after it's spent.

playing.title: Deny free scaling by shoving pre-6
playing.detail: Since she out-scales you level 14+, push waves hard before both level 6 ults to bank plates and tempo rather than passing up minion damage to look for even trades.

playing.title: Punish her R commitment
playing.detail: Grand Challenge requires her to hit all four vitals to execute — if she whiffs the ult engage, her damage output craters; this is your best all-in window of the whole game.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoners here are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning — bait timing, vitals tracking, cooldown windows — is my own read of the kits, not a stat.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Fiora’s Riposte (W) while you are executing [Q] by moving away with [E]. Use your abilities whenever they come off cooldown while considering her Riposte (W).
